scenario.description: Two neighbors discuss a backyard tree situation that's causing a dog to bark continuously.

agent_a.name: Miles

profile.personality_and_values: Miles Hawkins, spontaneous and free-spirited, values sanctity and benevolence. He is impulsive and relies on his instincts when making decisions.
profile.public_info: Miles Hawkins, a chef, is a green thumb enthusiast and spends his free time tending to his kitchen garden, using some of his fresh produce in his dishes.

agent_a.goal: Trimming the tree due to its overgrowth (<extra_info>Extra information: you need to trim the tree because it's blocking sunlight to your house and causing a safety hazard</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Miles trims the tree because its overgrowth blocks sunlight to his house and poses a safety hazard.

agent_b.name: Ethan

profile.personality_and_values: Ethan Johnson, a creative yet somewhat reserved individual, values power and fairness. He likes to analyse situations before deciding.
profile.public_info: Ethan Johnson is famous for cooking Italian food.

agent_b.goal: Maintain peace and quiet in the neighborhood (<extra_info>Extra information: you have a dog who is sensitive to noise and gets agitated whenever tree trimming is going on. It's causing a disturbance.</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Ethan wants to maintain peace and quiet because his dog gets agitated by the noise from tree trimming.
